headline:
Fullscreen
Live Chat
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Make ONE polished Chrome extension store listing concept, a flat promotional design at exactly 1760 x 1120 pixels (11:7 landscape). Premium YouTube-like visual language: WHITE/off-white background, bold near-black typography, one thin vivid red rule. Exact very large headline at upper-left on two lines: "Fullscreen" and "Live Chat". Spell Fullscreen as one word. All headline words must be sharp and easily readable at 440x280 thumbnail size. No extra tagline required.
Lower two-thirds: a single generous widescreen original illustrative sunset travel video field, beautiful orange ocean sunset seen from a sailboat, cinematic warm natural imagery. Video almost full canvas width with subtle 8px rounded corners, no physical monitor, no room, no browser chrome. Overlay ONE realistic native YouTube live chat panel on the RIGHT INSIDE this video, occupying about 33% video width. It should strongly resemble the compact true native dark chat in the supplied image: #0f0f0f surface, no floating message bubbles. Header "Top chat" plus small down chevron and vertical three-dot menu. Six to eight compact flat rows; each row has a SMALL circular avatar then muted gray @handle then WHITE short message INLINE on the SAME row, naturally wrapping sometimes. Suggested entirely fictional handles/messages: @sunseeker What a view, @marin Miles of ocean, @ray That golden light!, @nova Let's go, @kit Beautiful sunset, @luca Love this stream, @moss 🌅. No row boxes, no colored chat bubbles, no anonymous placeholder bars. Compact ordinary UI typography; circular avatars 22px relative to the full 1760 canvas. Bottom composer: own small circular avatar plus minimal underlined "Chat..." input, small smiley and outlined send triangle. The chat is a plausible native UI, not a Slack/iMessage panel. Keep chat visibly subordinate to the words Fullscreen / Live Chat.
Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for authentic native chat structure, NOT subject/content; do not copy game, streamer, real usernames/comments, photographed person, source overlay or source logos. New travel imagery must be original. No logos, Chrome marks, YouTube play logo, endorsement badges, statistics, official claims, existing characters or real creators. Visually restrained, confident white/red product identity. Entire image is an illustrative promotion, not a claimed real screenshot.
conceptNote: 白地の大きな見出しと赤い罫線。夕景の旅配信を映像領域いっぱいに広げ、右側に余白を残してチャットを重ねる。

revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ads-marketing. TARGETED edit to supplied 07 listing promo only. Keep the overall 11:7 landscape ratio, white header with huge black exact "Fullscreen" and "Live Chat", thin red rule, original sunset sailing scene, native chat typography, seven compact inline avatar-grayhandle-whitemessage rows, Top chat header and underlined Chat... footer with smiley and send triangle. Do not alter headline words or their spelling.
CHANGE ONLY the video/chat relationship: the sunset boating scene must extend ACROSS THE ENTIRE FULL WIDTH of the lower video field, including BEHIND the chat, all the way to the right boundary. The dark chat is a FLOATING OVERLAY INSIDE that full-width video, NOT a right dock or separate side-by-side column. Inset the chat from the video's top, right and bottom by visible scenic margins, each at least 3% of video's width. Make overlay chat about 29–30% of video width, a little narrower and shorter than before, keeping all seven compact rows and composer. Viewers must clearly see the orange sunset ocean background above, to the right of and below chat. Chat #0f0f0f may be 94%opaque so it reads well, modest8pxcorners. The full sailing video landscape must be visibly continuous behind the chat; show warm ocean water along the right scenic margin and a clear piece of sunset sky above chat. Keep original remaining artwork/headline intact, no extra objects, no new logos, no new words, no physical devices. This is illustrative marketing, not an actual screenshot.
revisions.change: Extend sunset sailing video across the whole field; inset chat as an overlay with scenic margins above, right and below.
